jobs.title: Security Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Security Software Engineer

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others. 

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security-oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long-term security response for the entire operating system and open source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security-focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self-discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role

What you'll do

Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement, and document new security features 
  • Lead security-focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community 
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities 
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications 
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country-specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu 
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies 
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process 
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Results-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 

Optional skills we also value

  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel 
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language) 
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience 

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.description:
Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

If you’ve enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage.   • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels

  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging

jobs.title: Global Head of Sales
jobs.description:
Global Head of Sales

Lead the full SOUS sales organisation across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa, and turn a fast-scaling team into a repeatable international revenue engine.

Full-time

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role

We are live in three markets, our sales team is growing month on month, and restaurant demand is moving faster than we can hire. This is the moment to take the wheel.

As Global Head of Sales you own new business revenue across every market. You lead our Sales Leads in the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa and the Account Executive teams below them, and you build the organisation that takes SOUS from a fast-growing startup to the category leader for independent hospitality. It is a senior role with full ownership, real equity and a direct line to the founders.

Your team

You join the commercial leadership team and report directly to our CCO and co-founder. The Sales Leads for the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa report to you, together with their Account Executive teams. You work side by side with the Growth Lead, Partnerships and Merchant Success to run one commercial engine from first touch to growing customer.

Tasks

Your focus

  • Own global new business revenue and targets across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa
  • Lead, coach and grow the Sales Leads per market and their Account Executive teams
  • Turn our outbound-first motion into a predictable, scalable playbook that works in every market
  • Build the sales organisation for the next stage: structure, hiring, enablement and compensation plans
  • Prepare and open new markets together with the founding team

Key responsibilities

  • Set the global sales strategy, targets and forecast, and report on performance to the leadership team and board
  • Run the weekly sales rhythm: pipeline reviews, deal reviews, forecasting and one-to-ones with every Sales Lead
  • Design territories, segments (single outlet, multi-outlet and groups) and quota models that scale
  • Hire and ramp Account Executives at pace, with a clear onboarding and certification programme
  • Own the sales process and CRM discipline in HubSpot, together with Growth and Operations
  • Personally lead strategic multi-outlet and group deals
  • Build partner-sourced pipeline together with the Partnerships team
  • Bring market and customer insight back into product, marketing and pricing decisions

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, of which at least 5 years leading sales teams, including managers of managers
  • A proven track record of scaling a SaaS sales team in a high-velocity SMB or mid-market segment
  • Experience building or running sales across multiple countries
  • Background in hospitality tech, payments, marketplaces or vertical SaaS is a strong plus
  • A data-driven operator who is fluent in funnel metrics, forecasting and compensation design
  • You lead from the front and still enjoy closing a deal yourself
  • Fluent in English; Dutch or German is a strong plus

Benefits

  • Base salary of €90,000 to €115,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Uncapped bonus structure, tied to global revenue
  • Stock options in SOUS through our employee stock option plan (ESOP), sized for a senior leadership role
  • 25 holiday days plus Dutch public holidays, and 8% holiday allowance
  • Working side by side with the team at our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre
  • Personal development budget and direct access to an experienced leadership team
  • Laptop and the tools you need to do your best work
  • An ambitious team of food lovers, great lunches and the occasional canal trip

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
AI/ML Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany.

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.


Accountabilities:

In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field.

  • Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases.

  • Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products.

  • Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements.

  • Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users.

  • Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate.

  • Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements.

  • Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable.

  • Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings.

  • Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows.

  • Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices.

  • Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects.

  • Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs.

  • Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact.

    • Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems.

    • At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement.

    • At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept.

    • Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement.

    • Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation.

    • Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline.

    • Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship.

jobs.title: Telemedicine Registered Nurse (RN), Consultant
jobs.description:
Telemedicine Registered Nurse (RN), Consultant

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

This is a contractor engagement of approximately 20-40 hours per week, with scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the first clinical reviewer of inbound member messages, triaging for urgency, escalating to a physician when needed, and routing non-clinical threads to the appropriate support team.
  • Deliver member education on menopause staging, hormone therapy, preconception health, metabolic health, and medication administration.
  • Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals.
  • Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.
  • Document all clinically relevant interactions same-day, create tracked internal tasks with named owners, and follow established escalation pathways.
  • Maintain active NLC multi-state licensure, complete required credentialing and onboarding, and adhere to HIPAA, continuing education, and liability coverage requirements.
  • Contribute to chart audits and clinical protocol feedback as the telemedicine program scales.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent record of accurate, protocol-aligned triage with appropriate physician escalation and no missed critical lab values.
  • Maintained same-day documentation and timely lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Delivered high-quality member education across menopause, preconception, hormone therapy, and metabolic health topics, reflected in strong member experience results.
  • Managed care coordination workflows reliably within your coverage window, including referrals, records retrieval, prior authorizations, and pharmacy callbacks.
  • Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An active, unrestricted RN license with NLC (Nurse Licensure Compact) multi-state privileges, in good standing, plus an ADN or BSN from an accredited program (BSN preferred).
  • A minimum of 3 years of active RN clinical experience, with meaningful experience in women's health, reproductive health, OB/GYN, fertility, endocrinology, or menopause care.
  • Demonstrated nurse triage experience, including assessing urgency, applying protocol, escalating appropriately, and recognizing critical lab values.
  • A clear understanding of RN scope of practice and sound judgment about when to escalate.
  • Strong written communication for asynchronous messaging and a strong phone presence for symptom assessment and instruction.
  • Proficiency with EHR and telehealth systems, secure messaging, and e-fax workflows.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • The ability to commit to scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window, with a HIPAA-compliant, private home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, REI practice, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with preconception and fertility workup, including AMH and hormone panels, ovulation tracking, and cycle-monitoring labs.
  • Hormone therapy education experience, including prior authorization workflows.
  • Experience supporting members on anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.

Carrot's RN network is the front line of the telemedicine clinic. jobs.description:
AI Tooling Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in France.

We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team.


Accountabilities:

You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work.

  • Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release.

  • Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions.

  • Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context.

  • Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses.

  • Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability.

  • Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage.

  • Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls.

  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices.

  • Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications.

  • Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications.

  • Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools.

    • At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases.

    • Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users.

    • Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design.

    • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization.

    • Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client.

    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring.

    • Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions.

    • Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses.

    • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines.

    • Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality.

    • Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls.

    • Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket.

    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

      • Experience with Django and PostgreSQL, including vector search using pgvector.

      • Frontend development skills sufficient to build and maintain chat interfaces using React or Next.js.

      • Experience developing internal tools that achieve adoption among colleagues.

      • Familiarity with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or structured representations of organizational knowledge.

      • Experience implementing agent memory, multi-agent architectures, or advanced agent orchestration.

      • Previous experience working with remote, globally distributed teams.

        • Opportunity to join a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team.

jobs.title: Telemedicine Physician Consultant
jobs.description:
Telemedicine Physician Consultant

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
  • Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
  • Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
  • Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
  • Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
  • Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
  • Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
  • Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
  • A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
  • An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
  • For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
  • Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
  • Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
  • Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $120-$160. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: Technical Support Consultant
jobs.description:
Technical Support Consultant Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

  1. Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.
  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.
  4. Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.
  5. Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.
  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager Embedded
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager Embedded

Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.

Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was.


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management
  • Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed
  • Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams
  • Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such
  • Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream
  • Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops
  • Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge

    • Your Profile ✨
  • Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations
  • A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers
  • Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you
  • Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly
  • Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill
  • A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero
  • Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors

    • Nice to have
  • German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German
  • Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing
  • Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel)

    • Your Benefits 🪴
  • Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
  • Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation
  • Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days
  • Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more
  • Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences

We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. You dive into each merchant's online performance, find the biggest opportunities and help them capture them. What you learn flows straight back into our product and playbooks.

We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is looking for a Compensation Business Partner to ensure our compensation philosophy, principles, and practices extend to all of our markets outside of the US, initially focused on EMEA and APAC.

This will be our first Compensation Business Partner dedicated to our international business sitting within the EMEA region, and an opportunity to help shape how Harvey approaches compensation as we continue to scale globally. You’ll partner closely with our People Business Partners, Recruiting team, business leaders, and the broader Compensation team to ensure our programs remain competitive, thoughtful, and scalable across markets.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep compensation expertise with strong business judgment. You should be equally comfortable analyzing market data, advising a recruiter on a complex offer, partnering with a PBP and developing a point of view on how Harvey should approach compensation in a new or rapidly evolving market. This is a highly collaborative role that will have a great degree of partnership across many functions.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Compensation Business Partner for EMEA and APAC, developing deep context on our teams, talent markets, and hiring needs across the regions.

  • Partner closely with People Business Partners and business leaders on compensation decisions including new hires, promotions, internal mobility, and other complex compensation questions.

  • Build a particularly strong partnership with Recruiting, advising on offers, market competitiveness, and candidate-specific situations.

  • Help evolve Harvey's international compensation strategy as we scale, including our approach to geographic differentiation, market positioning, salary structures, and equity.

  • Bring deep equity expertise and help translate Harvey's equity philosophy across markets where candidate expectations and familiarity with US-style equity compensation can vary significantly.

  • Research emerging compensation practices and talent trends, particularly across the rapidly evolving AI market, and turn external data into clear recommendations for Harvey.

  • Conduct market analyses using compensation survey data and other sources, while applying judgment.

  • Partner with the broader Compensation team on compensation cycles, benchmarking, band development, and company-wide programs, ensuring international considerations are represented from the beginning.

  • Identify where our US practices translate internationally—and where they don't—and proactively recommend changes as Harvey enters and scales in new markets.

  • Help build the infrastructure, principles, and enablement that will allow Harvey's international compensation approach to scale.


What You Have

  • 5-7+ years of experience in compensation

  • Experience supporting international compensation across EMEA and/or APAC.

  • Experience working for a US-headquartered company, with a strong understanding of how global compensation programs are designed and adapted for international markets.

  • Meaningful experience with equity compensation, including the ability to explain and advise on equity in markets with different norms and expectations.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment; you are comfortable building while the company and market are changing around you.

  • Strong knowledge of compensation fundamentals including market benchmarking, salary structures, job leveling, offers, promotions, retention, and pay decisions.

  • Exceptional business partnership skills. You can build trust with leaders, PBPs, and recruiters while being willing to challenge assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills paired with excellent judgment—you know when the data is telling you something and when it requires additional context.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine appetite to become an expert on the AI talent market, including proactively researching competitors, compensation trends, and emerging practices.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building new approaches rather than relying on an established playbook.

  • Ability to communicate complicated compensation concepts simply and credibly to audiences with very different levels of compensation expertise.

What we look for in you?

  • Operations Skills: You have the foundational knowledge of multiple areas of the Operations functions - Customer Support, Curation, Due Diligence, Trend Analysis, Relationship Management, Presentation, etc.

jobs.title: Director Technical Support & Field Service
jobs.description:
Director Technical Support & Field Service

Who We Are:

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world, moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

Our AI-driven pick-and-place and returns-handling cells combine robot arms, adaptive force-controlled grippers, AI vision and a safety cabinet, all driven by Cortex, our vision-language-action model. They run in live warehouse and logistics operations across the EU and US, and our deployed fleet is growing from around 50 cells to several hundred. Customer uptime now needs a dedicated owner. We're looking for a Director of Technical Support to build our customer-facing support function, covering everything from a customer opening a ticket to a cell back at target uptime. This is a player-coach role: you will stay hands-on technically while you hire the team and put the systems in place. You will work closely with our Hardware Product Engineering and Supply Chain leads.

Your Responsibilities:

Support Desk & Remote Diagnostics

  • Stand up the support desk, including ticket intake, triage, severity tiers, response and restore targets and an SLA framework

  • Define a coverage model for the EU and a plan for US time zones as the fleet grows

  • Build remote diagnostics on top of Cortex telemetry so most issues are triaged and fixed without a site visit

Escalation & Field Service

  • Run a closed escalation loop with Engineering, so field failures are triaged, root-caused and fixed in the product

  • Coordinate field service, including dispatch, on-site playbooks and third-party field technicians where needed

  • Identify the top recurring field failures and get them onto the product roadmap

Spares, RMA & Customer Enablement

  • Own the customer-facing RMA process and spare parts availability at customer sites, working with Supply Chain on procurement and logistics

  • Build customer onboarding, operator training, documentation and a knowledge base so customers can handle routine issues themselves

Metrics & Team

  • Own fleet uptime, MTTR, first-contact and first-visit resolution, SLA attainment and CSAT, and drive them up as the fleet grows

  • Hire and lead the first support and field engineers

  • Take front-line support duty off the founders and wider team

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • 8+ years in technical support, field service or after-sales for complex hardware, including several years leading teams

  • A track record of building a technical support, field service or after-sales function from scratch for a deployed hardware product as the installed base grew from tens to hundreds of sites

  • Hands-on experience setting up remote diagnostics and telemetry, ticketing and SLAs, escalation to engineering, spares and RMA, and field service coordination

  • Degree in mechatronics, electrical or mechanical engineering, automation or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Skills

  • Technical depth in mechatronics, controls or robotics, plus comfort working with software and telemetry data

  • Strong command of service metrics such as MTTR, uptime, SLA attainment and first-contact resolution

  • Calm, structured escalation management with customers and internal teams

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites

Additional Skills / Nice to Have

  • Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, AMRs or industrial automation, or in service for other deployed complex hardware such as energy storage, drones, medical or lab equipment, semiconductor equipment or machinery

  • Experience with IoT fleet monitoring or remote telemetry tooling

  • Experience running service coverage across the EU and US

  • Background in application or commissioning engineering

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing Series B robotics company

  • Flexible PTO and a collaborative, high-ownership culture

  • Ownership of how our customers experience Sereact once their cells are live

Senior Product Manager - Containers & Automotive Intelligence
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Containers & Automotive Intelligence
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

Kpler is expanding its Maritime & Logistics offering through two complementary products: Container Intelligence and Automotive Intelligence. Container Intelligence builds on Kpler’s existing container tracking capabilities, providing per-container ocean visibility alongside insights into terminal congestion, queues, stay and wait times, and predictive vessel ETAs and ETDs. Automotive Intelligence represents a new product opportunity, transforming Kpler’s data into a dedicated workspace for the automotive sector.

As a Senior Product Manager, Container & Automotive Intelligence, you will own both products end to end, balancing the growth of an established offering with the development and launch of a new product from the ground up. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing and sector teams, you will define product strategy, prioritise roadmaps, lead customer discovery and drive go-to-market execution.

For Container Intelligence, your focus will be on expanding product capabilities, improving prediction quality and coverage, and increasing customer adoption and commercial growth. For Automotive Intelligence, you will work with the Automotive Sector Lead, Data Engineers and Automotive Analyst to shape the product strategy, define the initial offering and deliver a first release targeted for early 2027.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional who can manage multiple workstreams in parallel, make clear trade-offs and deliver data-driven products in an evolving market. You will be expected to take a pragmatic, iterative approach, launching products and capabilities efficiently before continuously improving them through customer feedback and market insights.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Container Intelligence and Automotive Intelligence, balancing customer needs, commercial impact, development effort and data readiness across both products.
  • Drive delivery across both product teams, maintaining clear priorities, healthy backlogs and predictable release cadences while making trade-offs explicit when competing priorities arise.
  • Lead customer discovery across both segments, translating customer feedback and market opportunities into prioritised product requirements and roadmap decisions.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing and sector teams to align product development, share capabilities and deliver customer value.
  • Optimise Container Intelligence by expanding terminal congestion, dwell-time and vessel ETA/ETD prediction capabilities, improving data coverage and prediction quality across the web application and API.
  • Build Automotive Intelligence from the ground up, translating sector strategy and customer needs into a product roadmap, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria across seven intelligence modules.
  • Define the Automotive Intelligence workspace, bringing together trade flows and lane capacity, schedule reliability, fleet supply and renewal, charter rates and asset values, ports and terminals, and fuel, emissions, CII and bunkering insights into an actionable product experience.
  • Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, while securing design partners and supporting early customer adoption for Automotive Intelligence.
  • Establish clear product success metrics and trusted methodologies, tracking adoption, engagement, customer outcomes, ARR and customer logos, and using performance insights to guide ongoing product development.

    • Skills & Experience
  • 6–10 years of senior product management experience in a B2B data, analytics or SaaS environment, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.
  • Experience managing multiple products or workstreams simultaneously, including taking a product from concept to launch while growing an existing product in the market.
  • Experience working with data-heavy products, with an understanding of data sources, pipelines, technical dependencies and their implications for product strategy and delivery.
  • Strong product discovery skills, with the ability to translate customer needs and market insights into clear product direction and prioritised roadmaps.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Data teams to deliver data-driven products.
  • Relevant experience in maritime, shipping, container logistics, automotive or trade intelligence, with an understanding of concepts such as AIS, ports and terminals, ETA prediction and emissions regulation, including EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime and CII.
  • Experience with product roadmap prioritisation, backlog ownership and delivery planning across multiple teams or workstreams.
  • Understanding of go-to-market planning, including product positioning, packaging and pricing input.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and commercial teams and external customers.
  • A self-directed and decisive approach, with the ability to make trade-offs, take ownership of outcomes and operate with limited supervision.
  • A pragmatic, action-oriented mindset, with the ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver iteratively.

    • Nice to have
  • Experience developing and managing API-based products.
  • An established network across shippers, freight forwarders, carriers, car manufacturers or car carriers.
  • Familiarity with container movements, voyage legs, port calls and wider maritime and trade data concepts.
  • Experience using product management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?
