jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.description:
Head of Product Design
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

Explore your future career  🔭

As the Head of Product Design at Malt, you will lead a high-impact segment of our design organization, acting as a strategic partner in shaping how freelancers and clients connect, transact, and collaborate globally.

Your mission is to elevate Malt’s core product experience by connecting exceptional user experiences directly to commercial growth. Under your leadership, your initiatives will drive demonstrable lifts in core user health metrics, conversion funnels, and key commercial KPIs. You will ensure the product design function is staffed with top talent, fostering a culture of strong psychological safety and maintaining a high craft quality bar.

Reporting to Stefanie Fleisch (VP of Design), you will take a holistic view of our primary product domains. Your goal is to break down feature silos across multi-squad streams, delivering cohesive user journeys that are intuitive, clean, and built to scale.


Key Responsabilities ✨

 

  • People Leadership: Proactively develop strategies to accelerate team growth and independently manage your team’s performance. Foster an environment of open feedback and run an effective meeting cadence.

  • Experience Strategy & Roadmap: Define the overarching experience strategy and directly influence multi-team roadmaps, connecting the user experience to commercial growth.

  • Craft Direction & Vision: Set the aesthetic vision and interaction bar for your product area, translating brand strategy into specific design principles and facilitating high-standard critiques.

  • User Discovery & Research: Instill consistent, data-informed discovery habits across your teams. Initiate and drive strategic initiatives for the systematic collection of quantitative and qualitative user data.

  • Velocity & Execution: Optimize our design-to-delivery lifecycle. Help teams navigate the balance between shipping fast MVPs and investing time into polished, highly refined user flows.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain a close partnership with product and tech leadership peers to influence product strategy and secure tech investment for a best-in-class user experience that unlocks commercial growth.

  • System-level Thinking: Partner with the Experience Systems & AI team to drive AI workflow automation and directly contribute to the core principles and architectural requirements informing the design system strategy.

  • AI Workflow Transformation: Evaluate, pilot, and establish operational standards and tooling for AI-assisted design across multiple teams to accelerate discovery, generation, and delivery cycles.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

     

  • Management Track Record: You have a proven history of directly managing and developing design talent within fast-paced product organizations.

  • Strategic Alignment: You treat design as a core business lever. You understand product metrics, conversion funnels, and marketplace dynamics.

  • AI User Experience: Hands-on experience tackling unique UX patterns for generative AI, such as designing for non-deterministic model outputs, prompt-guiding interfaces, or trust and transparency in AI-driven automation.

  • Interaction & UX Foundations: You excel at handling platform complexity across multiple domains. You know how to translate dense data states, complex workflows, and multi-sided user funnels into simple, predictable interfaces.

  • Data & Insights Driven: You value evidence over bias, routinely leveraging user research and product analytics to validate your team’s design choices.

  • B2B / Marketplace Experience: A solid background or preferred experience in B2B platforms or multi-sided digital marketplaces.

  • Language: Fluency in English is required.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀



  • First Call with Olivier, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer any questions you may have. (45 minutes)

  • Manager Interview with your future manager Stefanie Fleisch (VP of Design) to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (60 minutes)

  • Case Study preparation and presentation with your future manager and members of the Design and Tech Team (60 minutes)

  • Final Interview with the CPO, Sebastien Bardin, to discuss Malt’s long-term vision in terms of AI experience workflows at Malt (30 min) + Coffee with the team (30 min)

We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
HR Operations Specialist

Bij Quaker Houghton zijn we experts in de ontwikkeling, productie en toepassing van industriële procesvloeistoffen, smeermiddelen en coatings voor de maakindustrie. Wij spelen al jarenlang een belangrijke rol in de groei van ’s werelds grootste industriële en productiebedrijven, van de luchtvaart- en automobielsector tot de metaal- en energiesector. Vandaag de dag zijn wij wereldwijd actief, met ons hoofdkantoor gevestigd in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania (VS).

Quaker Houghton is een wereldwijd beursgenoteerd bedrijf met een unieke, samenwerkingsgerichte cultuur die de professionele groei van medewerkers stimuleert en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden biedt.

Over de functie

Wij zijn op zoek naar een HR Operations Specialist ter versterking van ons Global HR Operations-team. In deze functie ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers in Nederland en zorg je voor een soepele en positieve medewerkerervaring gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren van HR-processen, het onderhouden van personeelsdossiers, het ondersteunen van compliance-activiteiten en het samenwerken met collega's binnen HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll en de business. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om bij te dragen aan regionale HR-initiatieven en projecten die operationele excellentie en continue verbetering binnen de EMEA-regio stimuleren.

Dit is een uitstekende kans voor een HR-professional die graag werkt in een dynamische, internationale omgeving en passie heeft voor het leveren van hoogwaardige HR-dienstverlening en ondersteuning aan medewerkers.

Tasks

Wat ga je doen?

Beheer van de Employee Lifecycle

  • Beheren van HR-administratie en HR-processen gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle, van onboarding tot offboarding.
  • Opstellen en uitgeven van arbeidsovereenkomsten, contractwijzigingen en andere HR-gerelateerde documentatie.
  • Bijhouden van nauwkeurige personeelsgegevens en waarborgen van de datakwaliteit binnen HR-systemen.
  • Ondersteunen van organisatorische wijzigingen, waaronder promoties, overplaatsingen en andere personeelsmutaties.

Ondersteuning van medewerkers en leidinggevenden

  • Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor HR-gerelateerde vragen.
  • Tijdige, nauwkeurige en servicegerichte ondersteuning bieden aan medewerkers en leidinggevenden.
  • Complexe vraagstukken waar nodig escaleren of coördineren met de juiste HR-teams.

Onboarding en Offboarding

  • Coördineren van onboardingactiviteiten voor nieuwe medewerkers om een soepele start te waarborgen.
  • Samenwerken met interne stakeholders om onboardingvereisten te faciliteren.
  • Beheren van offboardingactiviteiten en medewerkers begeleiden gedurende het uitdiensttredingsproces.

Compliance en HR-administratie

  • Ervoor zorgen dat personeelsgegevens en HR-processen voldoen aan lokale wet- en regelgeving en bedrijfsbeleid.
  • Ondersteunen bij de administratie van lokale arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-programma's.
  • Assisteren bij disciplinaire trajecten, employee relations-zaken en compliance-gerelateerde activiteiten onder begeleiding van HR Business Partners.

HR-systemen en Continue Verbetering

  • Onderhouden en actualiseren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen.
  • Uitvoeren van periodieke data-audits om nauwkeurigheid en consistentie te waarborgen.
  • Ondersteunen van HR-projecten en procesverbeteringsinitiatieven gericht op het verhogen van operationele efficiëntie en het verbeteren van de medewerkerervaring.

Requirements

Wat breng je mee?

Opleiding

  • Bacheloropleiding in Human Resources, Psychologie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.
  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een functie binnen HR Operations, HR-administratie of People Operations.

Ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van Nederlandse arbeidswetgeving en HR-administratieve vereisten.
  • Ervaring met het ondersteunen van HR-processen gedurende de gehele employee lifecycle.
  • Ervaring met HRIS/HCM-systemen; ervaring met Workday is een sterke pré.
  • Ervaring binnen een internationale of multinationale werkomgeving is een pluspunt.
  • Een HR-certificering wordt beschouwd als een pré.

Vaardigheden

  • Sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief meerdere prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren.
  • Grote nauwkeurigheid en oog voor detail.
  • Klantgerichte instelling met een passie voor excellente ondersteuning van medewerkers.
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen.
  • Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken.
  • Flexibel en comfortabel in een veranderende omgeving, met oog voor procesverbeteringen.
  • Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office-applicaties, met name Outlook, Excel en PowerPoint.

Talen

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

  • Hybride werkmodel (3 dagen per week op kantoor in Uithoorn).
  • Toegang tot QH University (meer dan 500 leerprogramma's) en uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.
  • Vergoeding voor zorgverzekering.
  • Pensioenregeling.
  • Regeling voor het kopen en verkopen van vakantiedagen.
  • Exposure aan regionale HR-processen en samenwerking met diverse functies binnen EMEA.
  • Een collegiale en internationale HR-werkomgeving.
  • Well-being programma's, Colleague Resource Groups en andere aantrekkelijke DEI-initiatieven.
  • Global Giving-initiatieven met betaald vrijwilligersverlof voor een maatschappelijk doel naar keuze.

Deze functie biedt een uitstekende mogelijkheid om je carrière binnen HR Operations verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan medewerkers en de organisatie.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van industriële processen en werktuigbouwkundige oplossingen, actief in meer dan 40 landen. We blijven voortdurend verbeteren en innoveren zodat industriële producenten wereldwijd succesvol kunnen blijven in een snel veranderende wereld.

Vanuit meer dan 100 locaties werken onze engineers, chemici en industrie-experts nauw samen met klanten om hen te helpen nóg efficiënter en effectiever te opereren, wat de toekomst ook brengt.

Onze waarden

  • Live Safe
  • Exceed Customer Expectations
  • Drive Results
  • Embrace Diversity
  • Do Great Things Together

Onze kernwaarden vormen de basis van wie wij zijn als organisatie. Ze sturen onze beslissingen, inspireren ons dagelijks en dragen bij aan een veiligere en sterkere Quaker Houghton. Deze waarden vormen de leidraad voor zowel ons interne handelen als onze relaties met klanten, partners en de maatschappij.

EEO: Quaker Houghton zet zich in voor gelijke kansen op de arbeidsmarkt en een werkomgeving vrij van discriminatie. Sollicitaties zijn welkom van alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten, ongeacht geslacht, genderidentiteit, leeftijd, beperking, etnische afkomst, religie of seksuele gerichtheid. In lijn met de Europese Richtlijn Loontransparantie wordt de salarisschaal voor deze functie voorafgaand aan het sollicitatiegesprek gedeeld om transparantie en consistentie binnen ons wervingsproces te ondersteunen. Kandidaten worden niet gevraagd naar hun salarisgeschiedenis. Onze organisatie werkt met een gestructureerd functieniveau- en salarishuis om objectieve en consistente beloningsbeslissingen te waarborgen.

jobs.title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)

At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​.

  • Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​.

  • Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​.

  • Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​.

  • Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​.

  • Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​.

  • Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​.

  • Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​.

  • Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​.

  • Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​.

  • Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​.

  • Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​.

  • Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​.

  • Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​.

  • Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​.

  • A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​.

  • Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​.

  • Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. Principal Security Engineer, Product & Infrastructure
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Reporting to the CISO, you'll own the security roadmap for Pigment's product, infrastructure, and CI/CD environment, and you'll build much of it yourself.

This is a hands-on role: expect to read code, threat model new services, reproduce and triage vulnerabilities, dig through infrastructure configuration and build the automation that closes gaps.

You'll also set direction and bring product and engineering with you, but that influence comes from technical credibility and not process: the engineers you work with will take you seriously because you've been in the same code they have.

The scope is broad: application security, infrastructure security, detection and response, and the assurance work that keeps our certifications standing. You won't be covering it alone. The security team is seven people and growing, with colleagues already owning compliance, governance and security operations, so this role can go deep on product and infrastructure and not be spread too thin across everything. Nobody arrives fluent in all of it: we're looking for real depth in several of these areas and the judgement to grow into the rest.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Product & Infrastructure Security Design - Design security features into the product itself and strengthen defence-in-depth across the platform. Threat model new services before they ship, and make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse later.

  • Security Review & Risk Assessment - Review code, architecture and configuration yourself, and be the person developers and PMs bring problems to early rather than late. Deliver solutions that balance risk against business benefit, and escalate the calls that genuinely need senior arbitration.

  • Assurance & Testing - Run our assurance programme: internal code, architecture and configuration reviews, red team exercises, and the bug bounty. Own the relationship with third-party auditors, and measure the control KPIs that keep our certifications defensible.

  • Vulnerability Management - Own vulnerabilities from detection through to verified fix: reproduce them, score and triage them, design or validate the mitigation, and confirm it actually worked. Improve the KPIs that tell you whether the process is holding.

  • Detection Engineering - Build and improve our detection capability alongside the infrastructure and engineering teams: identify the signals worth collecting, write rules that catch real attacks without drowning us in noise, and build the response playbooks behind them.

  • Incident Response - Lead security investigations into the production environment end to end, from first signal to root cause, across incidents and fraud. Flag the repetitive work worth automating and the detections worth building, and hand those to the security operations team.

  • SDLC - Set the technical direction for how engineers at Pigment build securely: guidance, paved paths, and reviews that teach and not just gate. Contribute to company-wide awareness where it counts, but your primary audience is product, engineering and SRE.

 

Example projects that would fall under your responsibilities (actual examples of recently completed or currently on the roadmap):

  • Secure the design and development of our AI features, including the MCP Server and Modeler Agent: threat modelling, design reviews, working alongside the engineers building them, and security assessments. 

  • Work out where AI-assisted analysis actually belongs in our pipeline. AI-powered security reviews reason about a diff semantically rather than pattern-matching it, which is genuinely different from classic SAST - but it's not a drop-in replacement, and figuring out the split between AI review, traditional SAST and SCA is an open question we'd like you to answer with evidence rather than vendor claims.

  • Migrate GitHub to managed identities: provisioning through Okta, retiring personal accounts and long-lived PATs, and moving CI to short-lived OIDC credentials instead of stored keys.

  • Design agent identity for the MCP Server - delegated access tokens, token exchange, and making sure an agent acting for a user can never exceed what that user could do themselves.

  • Push least privilege further across production and CI/CD. Better than it was, not where we want it.

For a concrete example: here's how we built a sandboxed execution environment for LLM-generated code.

Technical Environment

Mostly production, with the occasional internal IT-adjacent project:

Sr. Manager, Data Engineering

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure.

You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions.

Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs.
  • Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL.
  • Architect and optimize data warehouse models that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting.
  • Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance across all data systems.
  • Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance, including documentation and metadata practices.
  • Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas and event models with analytics and reporting in mind.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Own team-level planning and execution, including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams.
  • Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap with measurable outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers.
  • Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions, vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Elevated the maturity and consistency of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability.
  • Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business.
  • Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization.
  • Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts.
  • Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years leading and managing data or software engineers.
  • 5+ years of advanced SQL and 5+ years of Python development experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing.
  • Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines in production.
  • Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow).
  • Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles, plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards while remaining capable of direct technical execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Direct experience with Carrot's current tech stack: Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS.
  • Experience with enterprise BI platforms and enabling self-service analytics.
  • Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems.
  • Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment, ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs.
  • Healthcare industry experience, including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR).

Why This Role Matters

The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability.

The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the company's long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $170,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Product Design Lead

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

About Carrot

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family-building platform providing care for everyone, everywhere. Trusted by more than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems, Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for employers and award-winning experiences for millions of people worldwide. From maternity through menopause and pre-pregnancy through parenting, Carrot is dedicated to expanding access and improving outcomes. Carrot empowers members with compassionate, personalized, and inclusive support.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape the end-to-end experience for members. You'll own design from concept through execution for our mobile app priorities. You'll report to our Director of Product and be the design lead for this team, with the opportunity to pair with product designers working on other parts of the Carrot experience.

The work spans two levels. You'll go deep on individual mobile-first experiences, including Sprints, our program for members working on their metabolic health alongside fertility, pregnancy, and menopause care. You'll also design how distinct pieces of the member experience fit together into one seamless mobile experience.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own mobile design end to end — concept through high-fidelity execution on iOS and Android.
  • Bring the pieces together — design the information architecture and navigation that make distinct parts of the member experience feel like one product.
  • Design for return, not just first use — drive adoption and retention through experiences that earn a member's attention daily, weekly, and monthly.
  • Make complexity feel simple — turn large, dynamic, nuanced information into something members trust at a glance.
  • Partner closely with our Content Designer so visual and written communication land as one experience.
  • Ground decisions in evidence — run qualitative and quantitative research, and use it to back what we build.
  • Grow our design system with accessibility, consistency, and scalability in mind.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Shipped design work that measurably moved member adoption and engagement, with metrics you can point to.
  • Conducted user research and testing and developed a sharp sense of updates to best drive member engagement and business goals.
  • Contributed to our design system- letting teams ship faster and more consistently.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • 10+ years in product/UX design, with a portfolio of mobile-first work and end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-step journeys
  • Experience building and working on consumer apps focused on daily and weekly active usage
  • A track record designing for engagement and retention — habit formation, behavior change, wellness, or similar
  • AI as a core part of your design practice, plus experience designing AI-powered product experiences
  • Systems thinking to create experiences that feel clean and simple for users
  • Strong visual and interaction craft, hands-on prototyping, and fluency with building products people love to use
  • Experience leading user research or usability testing

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience with behavior change frameworks or gamification
  • Experience helping teammates develop as designers
  • Empathy and sensitivity to the challenges of healthcare journeys

Why This Role Matters

Fertility, pregnancy, and menopause care unfold over years, not appointments. Much of what shapes a member's outcome happens between clinical visits. Nobody returns to an app out of obligation — they return because it's useful, respects their time, and doesn't make them feel judged. Design is the difference.

Engagement here isn't a vanity metric; it's how the product does anything at all for a member's health. You will shape that experience, with the opportunity to put your work in front of millions of people.

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
jobs.description:
Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH

Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)

Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. 

 

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own

  • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

  • Engineering ways of working: code review standards, quality gates before release, build and release pipeline, and a deliberate plan to reduce hotfixes and technical debt.

  • Architecture and platform: owning the technical foundations shared across our games, including our in house SDK, analytics tracking, live configuration and the setup of A/B tests.

  • Delivery partnership: working with the producers who lead our cross functional game teams on estimates, capacity and technical risk, and having the final say on whether a release is technically ready to ship.

  • Transparency: making engineering progress, quality and capacity visible to the rest of the company through clear, measurable indicators.

What you bring

  • At least four years managing an engineering team of five or more people, including performance management and hiring.

  • A strong engineering background of your own, ideally in C#, Unity or mobile development, so you can lead architecture and review decisions with credibility.

  • A proven track record of success in a commercially driven company operating live products with real users, where engineering decisions are made against business priorities.

  • A track record of raising quality and delivery predictability in a small or fast moving company, with concrete examples of what you changed and how you measured it.

  • Comfort with direct conversations and with holding people to clear standards: Open, respectful, goal orientated.

  • A pragmatic, data driven approach: you decide based on what the numbers show, and you introduce the process only where it pays back.

Strong plus

  • Experience in frequent shipping of mobile games, ideally free to play, casual or hybrid casual titles.

  • Hands on knowledge of ad monetisation and mediation SDKs, mobile measurement partners and A/B testing infrastructure.

  • Experience introducing CI/CD, automated testing or release quality gates in a game studio.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to Sunday: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

If you want to build the future of digital companionship, Sunday is your home. Apply now!

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Cloud Security Engineer

YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.


🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

  • Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

  • Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

  • Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

  • The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

  • The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

  • Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

  • Secure design across the pods. Threat modelling and design review that enables engineers rather than gatekeeping them and raises the standard of what they ship

  • The security function itself. Set the priorities and the roadmap from actual risk, not security theatre. Decide what we build, buy, automate or leave for later. Grow the team and hire into it, represent security to enterprise clients and carry our SOC 2 programme on Drata. Compliance is part of the job and it is not the centre of it

🚢 What you'll secure

  • An AI search and recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration, SSO, client security reviews, GDS integrations

  • A content enrichment API sold as SaaS: high scale, public facing, data and AI heavy

  • The platform underneath: a client console with organisations, projects and API tokens, supplier and business-client integrations, data ingestion, an MCP server, and several LLM providers behind a single internal library

📚 Our stack

  • Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Redis Asynq queue

  • Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, Cloudflare in front

  • Observability: Jaeger tracing, BetterStack for logging, alerting and on-call

  • Compliance: Drata, SOC 2 in progress

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, used across the whole team

✅ You must have

  • 5+ years of hands-on security work spanning more than one discipline. Not five years of engineering with some security in it. This role sets the standard for the company, so it needs someone who has seen enough to have judgement rather than opinions

  • Application security depth. You know how modern web applications and APIs are attacked. You can validate an issue yourself through code review or a targeted penetration test and work with the engineer on the fix

  • A strong grasp of authentication and authorization. OAuth and OIDC, sessions, token handling, access control and the failure modes behind most API breaches

  • Cloud security fundamentals, properly. Identity, network, workload and pipeline security on a modern cloud platform, applied to production systems you were responsible for

  • Defensive experience alongside the offensive. You have investigated real incidents. You have built or improved the detection and alerting that catches them

  • Threat modelling and secure architecture for cloud, container and API systems

  • An engineering background. You are comfortable in a codebase, you can review what our engineers and our AI tools produce and you can build what you need yourself. Our backend is Go. Prior Go experience is a plus and not a requirement

  • Comfort in resource-constrained environments. Startups, small security teams or consultancies taught you to prioritize on risk, business impact and available resources and to execute yourself

  • The appetite to build a team. You want to grow this function and eventually lead it. Prior leadership experience is a plus and not a requirement. We would rather have depth and develop the leadership than the reverse

  • Working proficiency with Claude Code. Share specific examples

  • Judgement about pace. You secure a company that ships daily without becoming the reason it stops. Guardrails over gates

  • Experience of SOC 2, ISO 27001 or demanding enterprise security reviews

  • Excellent spoken and written English. You will talk to auditors, client security teams and our own engineers, often in the same week

  • ⚠️ European or African time zones (±3 hours from CET)

  • Available full-time (40 hours per week)

🌟 Nice to have

  • AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, model security, retrieval pipelines. Very few security roles let you both use AI as your main tool and secure it as your subject. This one does

  • Early security hire experience. You have been the first or one of the first security hires at a startup or scale-up

  • Experience leading or mentoring security engineers

  • Go

  • Security tooling or automation you built yourself

  • MDM, endpoint protection and identity provider administration (Google Workspace or similar)

  • Compliance automation tooling (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe or similar)

  • Security certifications. Valued as a signal, never required

  • GDPR depth. Travel or GDS exposure

  • German

❤️ You are a great fit if you

  • See security as an engineering discipline. You ship fixes and guardrails, not slide decks

  • Can explain a vulnerability to an engineer and its business risk to a client's security lead in the same afternoon

  • Have done offensive work as a penetration tester or consultant and wanted broader ownership than producing reports

  • Want to build something and own it, rather than advise on someone else's

  • Are comfortable challenging unnecessary security bureaucracy and genuinely risky engineering decisions alike

  • Get frustrated when a security fix takes weeks instead of days

jobs.description:
(Senior) Commercial Customer Success Manager (d/f/m)
Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.

Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Als (Senior) Commercial Customer Success Manager (d/f/m) übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:
  • High-Level Customer Success: Verantworte ein Portfolio unserer größten und anspruchsvollsten Enterprise-Kunden in Deutschland. Entwickle maßgeschneiderte Erfolgsstrategien, die komplexe Kundenanforderungen lösen und nachhaltig auf die langfristigen Ziele unserer Partner einzahlen.
  • Onboarding & Projektmanagement: Steuere das Kunden-Onboarding sowie die technische Projektabwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Stelle eine pünktliche, skalierbare und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sicher.
  • Strategisches Stakeholder-Management: Baue belastbare Beziehungen auf allen Kundenebenen auf – von operativen Event- und Box-Office-Teams bis hin zur C-Level-Ebene. Fördere das Engagement durch regelmäßige Business Reviews, Strategie-Workshops und vivenu Labs.
  • Beratung zu Wachstum & Transformation: Identifiziere und erschließe Umsatzpotenziale durch strategische Beratung zur Optimierung von Event-Setups, Pricing-Strategien und dem digitalen Kundenerlebnis.
  • Kundenzentrierte Transformation: Berate Kunden aktiv dabei, komplexe Ticketing- und Governance-Prozesse zu digitalisieren und neue, datengetriebene Geschäftsmodelle über die vivenu-Plattform umzusetzen.
  • Performance-Analyse & Health Monitoring: Analysiere relevante KPIs und Nutzungsmuster kontinuierlich, um Churn-Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Feature-Adoption und Kundenzufriedenheit einzuleiten.
  • Strategisches Verlängerungsmanagement (Renewal Management): Treibe Vertragsverlängerungen und Account-Expansions voran, indem du den klaren ROI aufzeigst, Produkt-Roadmaps abstimmst und langfristiges Vertrauen schaffst.
  • Stimme des Enterprise-Kunden: Vertrete die Anforderungen unserer Großkunden intern durch strukturiertes Feedback an unsere Produkt- und Engineering-Teams im Headquarter, um die zukünftige Plattformentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Enablement & Fortgeschrittenes Produkttraining: Befähige unsere Kunden durch gezielte Schulungen und Release-Briefings, das volle Potenzial fortgeschrittener sowie neuer Plattform-Features (z. B. AI-Agent, Marketing-Tools) vollumfänglich zu nutzen.

    • Das brauchst du, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein:
  • Enterprise-Beziehungsmanagement: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit verschiedenen Kunden auf mehreren Ebenen, einschließlich C-Level, operativen und technischen Stakeholdern.
  • Ticketing Operations / Branchenexpertise: Praktische Erfahrung im operativen Ticketing oder Arbeit bei einem Ticketing-Unternehmen (z. B. Ticketing-Plattformen, Veranstaltungsorte, Sportteams, Promoter oder Unterhaltungsorganisationen). Starkes Verständnis von Event-Abläufen, Box-Office-Workflows und dem gesamten Ticketing-Lebenszyklus.
  • Strategisches Portfolio- & Projektmanagement: Bewiesene Fähigkeit, ein strategisches Kundenportfolio zu managen und komplexe Onboardings, Plattform-Migrationen und Integrationen mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu liefern.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Vertrautheit mit APIs, Integrationen, Zugriffskontrollen und Enterprise-Plattformfunktionen, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte in operativen und geschäftlichen Mehrwert zu übersetzen.
  • Strategische Erfolgsplanung: Erfahrung in der Erstellung umsetzbarer Erfolgspläne unter Nutzung von Customer Discovery, CRM-Erkenntnissen, operativen Daten und relevanten Branchentrends.

jobs.title: Chief Science Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Science Officer

Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Responsibilities

  • Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments.

  • Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop.

  • Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next.

  • Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

  • Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard.

  • Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm.

  • Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join.

  • Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation.

  • Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML.

  • Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

  • Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

Not in scope, by design

  • Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next.

  • A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

  • Product roadmap and pricing.

What makes this role hard

  • Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

  • Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

  • A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses.

  • By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet.

  • By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning.

What you bring

  • You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it.

  • Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first.

  • Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join.

  • You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work.

  • You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it.

  • PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record.

Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first?

  2. If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop?

  3. How do you decide what to publish and what to keep?

What we offer

  • Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity.

  • Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in.

  • Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support.

How we hire

Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast.

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll join Pigment’s Reporting & Collaboration community, working as a senior hands-on Frontend Engineer on some of the most complex parts of the product.

This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences.


On the engineering part:
  • Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer, designing, building and shipping production features.
  • Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter.
  • Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets.
  • Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers and Engineers to take features from problem definition through to production.
  • Make pragmatic engineering decisions based on the needs of the product and its users, rather than pursuing technical complexity for its own sake.
  • Contribute to areas across Reporting & Collaboration depending on business needs and your interests, including data extraction and filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and emerging AI experiences.
  • Use modern engineering tooling, with Pigment teams working across GCP, CircleCI and AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

    • This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.

     


    On the people management part, here is what it entails:

    At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated.

    Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves.

  • Spend approximately 20% of your time on people management.
  • Gradually take on direct reports after establishing yourself as an IC during your probation period.
  • Coach engineers across different teams within the Reporting & Collaboration community.
  • Support engineers with career progression, development, feedback and performance.
  • Run regular 1:1s and help engineers understand what they need to do to progress.
  • Set clear expectations and provide actionable feedback.
  • Handle difficult performance conversations when necessary and follow through with clear development plans.
  • Partner with Tech Leads to understand how your reports are performing technically without taking ownership of the Tech Lead's responsibilities.
  • Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work.

    • Engineering Managers typically support engineers across multiple teams within their community rather than "owning" a single engineering team.

     


    Who you are

    We’re looking for someone who is both a strong senior Frontend Engineer and an experienced people manager.

  • Significant professional software-engineering experience, with the technical depth expected of a senior engineer.
  • Strong recent hands-on frontend engineering experience.
  • Production experience with React, TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
  • Previous formal people-management experience. Ideally, you have already managed engineers rather than looking for your first management opportunity.
  • Experience owning areas such as coaching, career development, feedback and performance management, not simply mentoring engineers or leading projects.
  • Experience building complex product interfaces, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics, data platforms or another sophisticated data-heavy product.
  • Experience solving frontend problems involving areas such as large datasets, visualisation, filtering, configuration, performance or complex workflows.
  • A strong product mindset. You care about what you're building, who is using it and whether it genuinely solves their problem.
  • Strong collaboration skills across Engineering, Product and Design.
  • The ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on in the code while managing people.
  • The autonomy expected of a senior IC: once you understand the problem, you can work with the team to move it forward without needing constant direction.
  • Fluent English. French is not required.
