jobs.title: Social Producer
jobs.description:
Social Producer

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een dynamisch team mooi werk maken? ACT. NOW!

ACT. agency staat voor Advertising, Content and Technology. Wij geloven in een geïntegreerde advertising en content aanpak. Met onze ACT.vertising zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven communiceren op de korte én lange termijn. Inmiddels werken we met +/- 30 mensen op mooie accounts als Noordhoff, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Odido, Ben, PwC, Daimler, Histor, en Het Prinses Maxima Centrum.

En we zijn nu op zoek naar een Social producer om onze social content elke dag scherper, sneller en beter te maken!

Taken

Over de rol
Als Social Producer ben jij de motor achter onze social contentproductie. Je regelt alles rondom shoots: begroting, planning, crew, locaties, materialen en de coördinatie op de draaidag zelf. Je werkt nauw samen met creatie, social media managers en editors, en zorgt dat elk stuk content, van een snelle TikTok tot een terugkerende videoreeks, op tijd, in de juiste kwaliteit en in het juiste format wordt opgeleverd. Jij houdt overzicht, denkt vooruit en lost problemen op voordat het problemen wórden.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Opstellen van productieplanningen en begrotingen voor shoots, in afstemming met account, creatie en social team
  • Organiseren en begeleiden van shoots: van pre-productie (planning, locaties, materialen, vergunningen) tot draaidag en post-productie
  • Opstellen van call sheets, draaischema's en shotlists

jobs.title: Medior Salarisadministrateur
jobs.description:
Medior Salarisadministrateur

Als onderdeel van Tenzinger ontzorgen wij organisaties door administratieve processen gedeeltelijk of volledig over te nemen. Met onze teams van experts, ondersteund door data en slimme AI-oplossingen, waarborgen we continuïteit, verbeteren we processen en geven we organisaties de ruimte om zich te focussen op hun eigen maatschappelijke missie.

Voor diverse zorginstellingen voeren wij de salaris- en HR-administratie uit. Dat doen we voor ongeveer 30 klanten, variërend van 4 tot 2500 medewerkers.
Ook helpen we onze klanten bij het inrichten van AFAS, vanuit de jarenlange ervaring die wij met deze software hebben.

We zijn aan het groeien en daarom zoeken we een nieuwe collega’s die het team komen versterken! We hebben mogelijkheden in Utrecht en in Hengelo en zoeken ook nog junior en senior collega’s (zie onze andere vacatures).

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

Samen met jouw team zorg je voor een correcte salarisadministratie van onze klanten in de zorg, waarbij je te maken hebt met de verschillende cao’s die de zorgsector kent. Afhankelijk van de grootte van de klant bedien je deze zelfstandig of met collega’s.

Het team bestaat uit 9 collega’s van junior tot senior, waar je een nauwe samenwerking mee hebt. De collega’s onderling zijn erg behulpzaam en je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te kunnen zijn. Op dinsdag en donderdag werkt het team vanuit het kantoor in Utrecht, de andere dagen kan je vanuit huis werken. Naast de operationele verantwoordelijkheid signaleer jij kansen tot het verbeteren en optimaliseren van de processen.
Je bent in staat om de klant te adviseren en denkt mee over de knelpunten waar de klant mee te maken heeft.

Je schakelt in deze rol veel met de afdelingen personeelsplanning, HR en de financiële administratie van de klant. We hebben veel kennis in huis rondom salarisadministratie, AFAS en cao’s, maar ook rondom data en procesoptimalisatie. Veel van onze klanten staan nog aan het begin van digitalisering van het administratieve salarisproces. Je bent dus echt samen met hen aan het bouwen!

Vereisten

Wat vragen wij van je?

Kennis van en ervaring met AFAS is een echte must voor deze rol.

Verder is het vooral belangrijk dat jij je fijn voelt in het team. Die kans is groot als jij:

  • behulpzaam bent: “‘één team één taak”;
  • hard kan werken én hard kan lachen;
  • je herkent in “doe maar normaal, dan doe je al gek genoeg”
  • graag kijkt hoe jij het werk slimmer en beter kan doen

Uiteraard beschik jij over de nodige accuratesse en heb je bij voorkeur al ervaring met het uitvoeren van de salarisadministratie voor meerdere klanten.

Verder:

  • Heb jij een relevante afgeronde opleiding op minimaal MBO+ niveau;
  • Beheers je de Nederlandse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift;
  • Ben je in het bezit van een PDL-diploma (VPS is een hele fijne bijkomstigheid);
  • Ben je 24-40 uur beschikbaar.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een kans om mee te groeien en je te blijven ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied én als professional. Je draagt direct bij aan een betere en efficiëntere zorg; je geeft onze klanten meer tijd en ruimte zodat zij zich kunnen richten op waar zij het beste in zijn: zorg verlenen. Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een bruto salaris tussen de € 3.400,- tot € 4.500,- op basis van 40 uur + kennis en ervaring;
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding en/of NS Businesscard;
  • Opleiding- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden; o.a. AFAS trainingen en trainingen om je inhoudelijke vakkennis te vergroten;
  • Een overheerlijke lunch in ons eigen restaurant;
  • Leuke collega’s, informeel samenwerken en leuke activiteiten!

Andere arbeidsvoorwaarden

Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken

  • Veilige werkomgeving
  • Laptop en mobiel van de zaak
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding en €500,- om je thuiswerkplek in te richten
  • 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen

Werken bij Stippt

Werk mee aan een slimmere administratie voor de zorg.
Bij Stippt krijg je verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om samen met vakgenoten onze dienstverlening steeds beter te maken.

jobs.title: Director - Specialty Fibers
jobs.description:
Director - Specialty Fibers

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Director of Specialty Fibers

This role ensures that every product made from cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, and other luxury fibers meets Quince's uncompromising standards for quality, sustainability, and affordability.

The Director blends deep technical expertise in fiber science with strategic supply chain leadership and cross-functional collaboration, serving as the central hub connecting sourcing, production, quality, and design teams across global markets.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Supply Chain Management

  • Orchestrate the end-to-end supply chain as the central hub connecting sourcing managers, production teams, and quality specialists to ensure a seamless, resilient, and efficient flow from fiber to finished yarn.
  • Lead and mentor a diverse, specialized team of sourcing managers, quality engineers, and production experts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Drive multi-sourcing and nearshoring strategies to mitigate geopolitical and logistical risks while ensuring a stable supply of high-grade fibers from the Americas and Asia.
  • Set the strategic direction for vertical integration opportunities, evaluating build-vs-buy decisions for spinning, dyeing, or finishing capabilities that could enhance quality control and margin structure.
  • Act as a key advisor to the executive team on fiber market trends, geopolitical risks (e.g., trade tariffs, export restrictions), climate impacts on raw material supply, and competitive intelligence—translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Champion Quince's "unreal prices" mission by continuously identifying cost-leadership opportunities across the supply chain, from farm to finished yarn, without compromising ethical standards or product integrity.

Sourcing & Supplier Development

  • Build and curate a best-in-class supplier ecosystem, identifying, vetting, and onboarding mills, dehairers, spinners, and dye houses that meet Quince's exacting standards for quality, capacity, sustainability, and labor practices.
  • Lead supplier development programs, coaching strategic partners to improve yield, reduce defects, adopt sustainable practices, and achieve cost efficiencies that benefit both parties.
  • Drive traceability and transparency across the entire fiber supply chain, from herder cooperatives and farms to finished yarn. Partner with certification bodies (GOTS, RWS, GCS, ZQ) to ensure chain-of-custody integrity.
  • Make high-stakes sourcing decisions based on deep market intelligence—including auction prices, crop forecasts, currency fluctuations, and geopolitical developments—balancing short-term cost opportunities with long-term relationship value.

Quality Assurance & Technical Optimization

  • Architect the quality management system for all specialty fibers, defining standards, testing protocols, and approval workflows for raw fiber, dehaired fiber, tops, yarns, and finished goods.
  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Natural Fibers Quality to establish measurable quality benchmarks, including micron distribution, fiber length, tensile strength, yield, color fastness, and pilling resistance—ensuring every lot meets or exceeds luxury brand parity.
  • Oversee third-party lab testing and compliance, working with the Cashmere Spec/Test Report/Compliance Auditor to validate that all materials meet international standards (ISO, OEKO-TEX, GOTS, REACH) and Quince's internal specifications.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for quality failures, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across the supply chain. Drive a culture of "quality at the source," empowering suppliers to self-detect and correct issues before production.
  • Collaborate with product development and design teams to translate aesthetic and tactile visions into technical specifications—micron targets, twist levels, finishing treatments—that are manufacturable at scale and cost.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the central point of communication for all fiber-related matters, providing technical expertise and clear direction to design, product development, and production teams.
  • Communicate daily with domestic and overseas mills, dye houses, and suppliers to give precise, actionable feedback on fiber quality, color accuracy, availability and production timelines.
  • Translate design and merchandising visions into clear, manufacturable technical briefs for suppliers, ensuring that product aesthetics and performance meet Quince's brand standards.
  • Lead blind panels with design, merchandising, and customer focus groups to validate luxury fiber perception and color accuracy before commercialization.

Qualifications

Required

  • Degree in Textile Science, Fiber Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain Management, Color Chemistry, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in specialty fiber sourcing, yarn production, quality management, or coloration for apparel, accessories, or home textiles.
  • Deep technical knowledge of natural fibers (cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, cotton), spinning processes (woolen, worsted)
  • Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced retail or manufacturing environment, with a track record of mentoring and developing talent.
  • Strong cost analysis skills: cost-per-kilogram modeling, yield optimization, landed cost analysis, and budget management.
  • Experience building and maintaining quality standards, and supplier compliance programs, including SKU rationalization and shade consolidation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience with sustainable fibers
  • Knowledge of supply chain traceability including blockchain or digital tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with PLM systems and quality database management.
  • Background in luxury goods (apparel, home and accessories) with an eye for premium aesthetics, handfeel, and trend forecasting.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$1—$2 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Curated Data
jobs.description:
Staff Software Engineer - Curated Data

About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

Dune's Vision

https://dune.com/blog/dune-vision

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Data Products builds and owns datasets end to end: from raw chain data through decoding to the 3000+ models and 4 petabytes we curate, share directly with customers, and replicate into their warehouses.

The role will focus on the lifecycle of building high quality data: orchestrating thousands of interdependent models, propagating schema changes without breaking downstream consumers, propagating corrections.
That is a software architecture problem in a data domain. This role is a hybrid: a backend engineer who thinks in systems and contracts, working on data.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will come back with a design, a sequence, and work the team can pick up, while building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will

  • Design and build the control plane for our curated data lifecycle: dependency-aware orchestration, backfills, restatements, retries, partial failure, and recovery

  • Decide, dataset by dataset, whether the answer is a model, a service or a job, and own that architecture through production

  • Design the contracts between ingestion and curation so a dataset can be reasoned about end to end

  • Build alerting and data quality signals that catch real problems and stay quiet otherwise, so on-call is about incidents rather than noise

  • Work across Go, Kotlin, Rust, Python and SQL, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

  • Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

You might be a great fit if

  • You are a backend engineer who has gone deep on data systems, or a data engineer who became a strong software engineer. You ship production services, not only pipelines

  • You have built or materially extended orchestration and scheduling systems, and can explain precisely what breaks at scale and why

  • You have handled schema evolution and data correctness in a system with real consumers downstream, where a breaking change has a cost

  • You have built or operated stateful stream processing in production (Flink,Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming, RisingWave, Materialize, Feldera)

  • You have strong SQL and modeling skills on large datasets, and an interest in how the query engine underneath actually executes your work

  • You have solid computer science fundamentals and distributed systems understanding

  • You debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds

  • You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus

  • Deep experience with a transformation framework such as dbt or SQLMesh: specifically, having hit its limits and built beyond them

  • Data lake formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

  • Stateful stream processing in production (Flink, Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming)

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

  • A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

  • We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

  • On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Chief Actuary
jobs.description:
Chief Actuary

The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

  • Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
  • Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.
  • Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
  • Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
  • Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
  • Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.
  • Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.

jobs.title: International Data Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
International Data Acquisition Manager

Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

As an International Data Acquisition Manager at Socure, you will be instrumental in expanding and managing our global data assets to power Socure’s identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance solutions. Your primary focus will be sourcing, evaluating, onboarding, and managing third-party data providers across international markets, with a strong emphasis on data quality, operational scalability, and regulatory compliance.

Reporting to the Head of Data Acquisition and Strategy, you will collaborate closely with the Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and external data partners. Together, you will identify and operationalize data sources to enhance product performance, broaden geographic reach, and drive Socure’s international growth.

This role is especially critical as Socure deepens its international investments, building in-region capabilities and expanding its product support in the EU, UK, LATAM, and other key markets.

What You'll Do

Vendor and Data Management

  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

  • Assist in preparing RFIs, RFPs, diligence materials, and vendor assessments to evaluate provider capabilities, data quality, compliance posture, operational fit, and commercial value.

  • Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle.

  • Help manage renewals and identify new vendors to improve product quality, expand coverage, and enhance cost efficiency.

Collaboration and Internationalization Strategy

  • Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Socure products and international scenarios to assess the relevance, incremental value, and risks of potential data sources.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to align on priorities, plan integrations, and ensure effective operationalization of new data sources.

  • Contribute to data acquisition that promotes inclusivity, coverage, and fairness in identity verification across diverse populations and regions.

  • Represent the Data Acquisition team in cross-functional meetings, clearly communicating findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Quality and Integration

  • Assist in due diligence for prospective data sources, including data quality assessments, overlap and coverage analysis, compliance reviews, and performance testing.

  • Support structured evaluations and proof-of-concept testing for new vendors and datasets using evidence-based methods to determine business value and product impact.

  • Monitor and report on data quality metrics, vendor performance, feed reliability, and issues such as drift, schema changes, or outages; help coordinate remediation as necessary.

  • Work with internal technical teams to plan integrations, including understanding schemas, APIs, delivery models, and operational dependencies.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage day-to-day operations across the international data acquisition lifecycle, including vendor communications, issue resolution, documentation, and follow-up on action items.

  • Track and document cost, usage, and value metrics for acquired datasets, supporting budgeting, renewals, prioritization, and vendor decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve evaluation frameworks, and scale the team’s operating model as international data needs expand.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data acquisition, vendor management, procurement, partnerships, data operations, or a related field.

  • Experience evaluating or managing third-party data providers, ideally across multiple markets or jurisdictions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess data quality, business value, and operational trade-offs.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory and privacy frameworks impacting data acquisition and usage, including UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and other relevant data protection requirements.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, including experience maintaining structured documentation and evaluation records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with data vendors in identity verification, fraud prevention, financial services, regtech, or compliance-related markets.

  • Familiarity with international identity, KYC/eKYC, or watchlist-related data ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of global data landscapes, including government, credit bureau, mobile network, utility, electoral, or equivalent data sources used in various countries.

  • Familiarity with data integration concepts, including APIs, batch delivery, schemas, and operationalizing external data feeds.

  • Experience using SQL or similar tools for data analysis, profiling, or evaluation.

  • Experience working with UK and European market data providers or supporting products in the UK and internationally.

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)

Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle gestaltest du CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung.

  • Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows.

  • Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen.

  • Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen.

  • Verständnis der Zusammenhänge zwischen CRM-Systemen, Datenquellen und technischen Abläufen sowie Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft.

  • Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft sowie sichere Anwendung von Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Plattformen als Core User.

  • Hands-on-Umsetzung von Maßnahmen – von der Konzeption und dem Flow-Aufbau bis zur Auswertung und Optimierung.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration.

  • Starke analytische Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Daten-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Kohortenanalysen oder vergleichbaren Experimenten.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Segmenten und automatisierten Journeys in einem datengetriebenen CRM- oder Lifecycle-Umfeld.

  • Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM- beziehungsweise Marketing-Automation-Plattform.

  • Technisches Grundverständnis für die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe von CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und relevanten Datenquellen.

  • Strategische und operative Arbeitsweise: Du identifizierst Hebel, setzt Prioritäten und setzt Maßnahmen selbstständig um.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)

Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

  • Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

  • Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

  • Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

  • Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

  • Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

Your profile

  • 7+ years running production infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

  • Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

  • Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

  • Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

  • MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

  • Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

  • Experience defining standards that other engineers work to, whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

Nice to have

  • PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

  • Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

  • AWS architecture certification

  • Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

  • Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

Our stack

Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

  • Lead commercial negotiations end-to-end, crafting tailored solutions through multi-year deals, renewal uplifts, and product cross-sells.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes.

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

    • Au-delà de 6 mois :

  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée

  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

jobs.title: Chief Physician / Head of Urology
jobs.description:
Chief Physician / Head of Urology

We are currently looking for an experienced professional to join an acute care hospital in the Zurich Oberland as Head of Urology. In this role, you will assume overall medical, financial, and personnel responsibility for the urology department, which handles approximately 850 inpatient admissions per year, and play a key role in shaping the future of urology in the region.

Responsibilities

  • Assume overall responsibility for the urology department in terms of medical care, financial performance, and personnel management.

  • Strengthen and further develop key specialisations, including uro-oncology with prostatectomy and nephrectomy, complex endourology, robotic surgery, transurethral therapies, continence, and sexology.

  • Ensure high standards of treatment quality and provide attractive training and professional development opportunities in collaboration with three senior physicians and affiliated physicians.

  • Lead a service-oriented, interprofessional department while ensuring efficient use of resources.

  • Maintain and expand regional partnerships with referring physicians, independent practitioners, and partner hospitals.

  • Support the department management in further developing the hospital's surgical specialties.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Specialist qualification in Urology and a Swiss subspecialty qualification in Uro-Oncology.

  • Several years of clinical experience, with broad specialist knowledge and extensive surgical expertise.

  • A confident, integrative leadership personality with strong interpersonal skills when dealing with employees, referring physicians, and partners.

  • An understanding of interdisciplinary and interprofessional collaboration on an equal footing, as well as basic business and financial knowledge.

  • Enthusiasm for training and mentoring younger colleagues.

  • Experience initiating, leading, and implementing projects.

Benefits & Culture

  • A high degree of professional autonomy and the opportunity to further develop and establish urology as a key specialty in the region.

  • A cantonal service mandate for prostatectomies and nephrectomies.

  • Modern infrastructure and state-of-the-art surgical equipment.

  • The opportunity to expand existing areas of specialisation and establish new ones together with the team.

  • Well-established interdisciplinary collaboration and short decision-making processes.

  • A teaching hospital affiliated with the University of Zurich, a central location near the train station, and either a ZVV BonusPass public transport benefit or affordable parking options

jobs.description:
Praktikum M&A (Buy & Build/Private Equity) - Ab sofort / Q1 2027

Wir sind ein Gründerteam (Backgrounds: HSG, ETH, BCG, Goldman Sachs) mit Track Record in Investments und Entrepreneurship. Im Zentrum unseres frisch gestarteten Private-Equity-Unternehmens bieten wir ein aussergewöhnliches Praktikum im Bereich Private Equity & Deal Execution. Dies ist deine Chance, direkt an der Analyse, Bewertung und Umsetzung von Transaktionen mitzuwirken, Seite an Seite mit unserem Deal Lead und den Mitgründern.

Aufgaben

  • Deal Sourcing & Screening: Identifikation, Ansprache und Erstbewertung potenzieller Zielunternehmen; Aufbau und Pflege einer strukturierten Deal-Pipeline
  • Financial Modeling: Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von LBO-Modellen (Kapitalstruktur, Financial Covenants, Returns-Analysen wie IRR/MOIC, Sensitivitäts- und Szenarioanalysen)
  • Due Diligence: Mitwirkung bei Commercial, Financial und Operational Due Diligence, inklusive Koordination mit externen Beratern (Wirtschaftsprüfer, Anwälte, Berater)
  • Investment Cases: Erstellung von Investment-Memoranden und Präsentationen für Investment Committees; Aufbereitung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Unternehmensanalysen
  • Transaktionsprozess: Begleitung des gesamten Deal-Prozesses von Term Sheet über SPA-Verhandlungen bis Closing, inklusive Datenraum-Management
  • Post-Merger-Integration: Je nach Bedarf Unterstützung bei der Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) von akquirierten Unternehmen kann ebenfalls Teil der Aufgaben sein

Qualifikation

  • Verfügbarkeit für mindestens 6 Monate in Vollzeit
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gutes Verständnis von Finanzkennzahlen, Bilanzierung und Bewertungsmethoden

jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description:
Tender Manager

Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

  • professionaliseren van HR-processen en versterken van de brede inzetbaarheid binnen het HR-team.

Vereisten

Je combineert gevoel voor wat belangrijk is voor de organisatie met de durf om stelling te nemen. Daardoor weet je wanneer je moet luisteren, doorvragen of duidelijk positie moet innemen. Tegelijkertijd is zichtbaarheid belangrijk: juist door regelmatig op locatie aanwezig te zijn, blijf je dicht bij leidinggevenden en medewerkers en weet je wat er binnen de organisatie speelt.

jobs.title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
jobs.description:
Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)

Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it.

We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany.

The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us.

The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch.

You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem.

Tasks

  • Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you.
  • Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives.
  • Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief.
  • Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you.
  • Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see.
  • Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly.

In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it.

Requirements

  • Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken.
  • Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months.
  • Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once.
  • Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines.
  • At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets.
  • Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance.

Nice to have, not essential

  • Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite.
  • Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail.

A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply.

Benefits

  • A monthly internship allowance
  • Hybrid, with agreed office days
  • Lunch with the team
  • A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing
  • A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. Knowing what a good afternoon feels like is part of the job

Sounds like your kind of work? Please apply with your CV and a cover letter, both in English.

jobs.title: Production Planner
jobs.description:
Production Planner

At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

Taken

The opportunity
Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations.

This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment

In this role, you will be responsible for

  • Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives.
  • Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability.
  • Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc.
  • Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment.
  • Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions.
  • Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities.
  • Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis.
  • Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles).
  • Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively.

Vereisten

You’ll bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required).
  • Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required).
  • Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach.
  • Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules.
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Benefits

What Harvey provides:
Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer

  • a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,-
  • a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn
  • an in-house fitness center
  • 26 vacation days
  • several fun company outings and parties each year

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Lead Product Manager

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.

That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation. Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.

This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

You Will:
